Chrome に追加
概要
Adds price history charts and the option to be alerted on price drops to all supported Amazon sites.
✦ Never Overpay on Amazon Again ✦

Stop guessing if a "sale" is actually a discount. Keepa® adds price history charts directly to Amazon product pages, allowing you to track prices, analyze trends, and make informed purchase decisions on over 7 billion products.
✓ Price History Charts
View interactive price history charts directly on the Amazon product page.
✓ Price Drop & Availability Alerts
Set up price watches to get notified when a product drops below your target price or returns to stock. Includes tracking for Lightning Deals.
✓ International Price Comparison
Compare and track prices across all Amazon locales to find the best international deals.
✓ Supports Multiple Amazon Marketplaces
Compatible with Amazon domains: .com, .co.uk, .de, .co.jp, .fr, .ca, .it, .es, .in, .mx.
→ Zero-Click Integration:
No account required to start tracking. Keepa integrates directly into the Amazon UI without cluttering your browser with unnecessary buttons.
Strict Privacy & Minimal Permissions
We engineer for privacy, utilizing Chrome's strict minimum permissions policy. The extension only requests what is necessary to function:
* keepa.com & Amazon Domains: Required to bridge our database with your browsing session, injecting the charts seamlessly onto the page.
* declarativeNetRequestWithHostAccess & Cookies: Powers the extraction algorithms that reveal hidden MAPs and third-party merchant stock counts.
* Storage: Caches your configuration settings locally in your browser.
* ContextMenus (Disabled by default): An optional toggle allowing you to batch-open multiple Amazon products on Keepa.com.
When you click an eBay link in the Keepa Box, it’s routed through the eBay affiliate program.
Review our privacy policy here: https://keepa.com/#!disclaimer
